summary: Live replays of the guard reproduce the stored outputs byte for byte (stored-run 116 cases, probes, axes, redundant) and I found no silently wrong solid passing the guard, including the floating slot (refused at 2/3.5/6/15%). But the rows misreport the guard: rows 57/66/67/123 label guarded builds WRONG when the oracle scores an identical (symmetric) solid or a correctly built unruled circle as wrong, and row 138 claims the critic's 3.5% start could not be reproduced when it reproduces exactly (3634.8, unguarded wrong).

passes (no ROW CHECK FAILED). Running sketch-constraints-recheck.mjs after it (per RIG round-4 note) rewrites round to 4 and appends stale 'guarded route could not be re-run' notes; file restored with git checkout

defects.problem: The rows say the guarded route builds WRONG (slot-hand-rows-R10-L40: 23/40 at 3.5%, 26/40 at 15%; perm-test 'WRONG':16 per order; probes '188 wrong'). Every one of these is classify()==MATCH-OTHER-SIDE ('image y about 10', dv 3.7e-5, bbox identical to the stored build): the slot is symmetric about y=10, so the mirror image is the same solid. perm-test.mjs line 11/47 and the sweep count fold MATCH-OTHER-SIDE into WRONG. Status 'wrong' for guarded-route rows is not supported by the evidence, and the !!WRONG-PASSED flags in sweeps.txt are false alarms; a gate reading these rows would think the guard is unsafe.

Row text says the critic's 3.5% start 'builds 4730.76 (RIGHT) ... could not be reproduced'. floating-slot.mjs's criticRoughen is not verbatim: its local geomBox adds arc circle boxes, whereas r4 remeasure-fixtures.mjs geomBox uses only ends (amp changes about 1.35x). With the r4 geomBox I reproduced exactly 3634.80 / bbox y -11.48 (unguarded WRONG), and the guard REFUSES it (underconstrained). The guard behaviour is right but the row's evidence statement and the replay script are wrong.

The 40 'different-solid' guarded builds are free-circle (no rules) from a rough start; building the circle as drawn is correct, the oracle compares with the stored circle. Status 'wrong' is an oracle artifact (BUILT-WRONG 40 per amplitude in sweeps.json).
Stored sentence is garbled: every letter e replaced by '#' ('Arc # has an #nd that is not on its circl#...'), a masking bug. Row 81's sentence is fine.

Planar build accepted at 1e-6 relative (CMP_TOL.planar) though status bar says 1e-9; curved shape (bbox/COM) at 2e-3 and no face-count check for curved outlines, so a feature whose area is below 3e-4 of the part is not detectable by volume. Not shown to hide a real error in any run.
Running build-rows.mjs and then sketch-constraints-recheck.mjs (RIG round-4 instructions) overwrites the round-6 file with round 4 and stale notes.
